title: Title with icon
description: A heading with icons between its words, plain or in a box. The icons play by themselves, one after another.
iconsNote: Each icon plays its default state, so any System Outline or System Solid icon will fit. Skip the In and Morph states here. The timing is set for animations of 1 s, the usual length; for an icon of another length, change the waits in its trigger so the script still lasts 5.5 s.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. Apart from the dots, this is the whole script.

fragments.title: Icons that play in turn
fragments.note: The icons play one after another, by themselves, with no script.

fragments.title: As tall as the text
fragments.note: Sized in em, so the icons follow the font size.

fragments.title: Icons in a box
fragments.note: The same title with the icons in boxes. The triggers are the same.

fragments.title: The box
fragments.note: The box grows and shrinks with the text, like the icons do.
